game.name: Super Smash Bros. Melee
game.rules:
**General**

- You must include a video of the entire run. *(Runs that were submitted prior to **April 13, 2019** without video proof have been "grandfathered in")*
- The game audio must be audible throughout the entire run.

**Emulator & ISO Loaders**

- **[Dolphin](https://dolphin-emu.org/download/)** is the only allowed emulator *(any other emulator, such as: Faster Melee, Slippi, etc, are not allowed)*.
- **Earliest allowed version:** 5.0
- **Latest allowed version:** Most recent "Release" version.
- [Nintendont](https://github.com/FIX94/Nintendont) is allowed to load ISO's on a console.

**Extra Rules For Emulators**

- You cannot load a savestate to reset. A reset/retry before your run, to ensure no savestates has been used, must be done. *(IL's: Retry the current level with **Pause+Z** / Full-game: Reset to the Main Menu/Level Select/Character Select Screen before starting the attempt, by pressing **L+R+A+Start**)*
- It's appreciated if you write which emulator version you used for your run, but it's not required.

**Banned**

- No disallowed mods *(Including but not limited to: 20XX, 20XXTE, UnclePunch, UCF, C-Stick Mod, Disable Tap Jump, etc). If you wish to use mods, go to the [Category Extension Leaderboards](https://www.speedrun.com/ssbm_ce))*
- Savestates *(Examples: To avoid RNG Manipulations, saving a good seed or achieve a specific Control Stick Recenter)*
- AR Codes & Gecko Codes / Other Cheat Codes
- Usage of the Master Hand Glitch. (Except for All Trophies, where it is allowed)

**Controllers**

- You are allowed to use the [Controller Adapter Polling Fix](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cQ3pbKZm_yUtcLK9ZIXyPzVbTJkvnfxKIyvuFMwzWe0/edit) (also known as 1000Hz Adapter Overclocking).
- Macros & Turbo functions is strictly forbidden.

**Software & Game Modifications**

- Changing Dolphin's Internal Resolution, Anti-Aliasing and Anisotropic FIltering is allowed.
- Using the [Melee HD Texture Pack](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SYItKN88hzg) is allowed.

relatedGames.name: Super Smash Bros. Melee Category Extensions
relatedGames.rules:
1. Runs must be Single Segment. 
2. Video proof of the entire run is required for all submissions. 
3. All game audio must be audible throughout the entire run. Make sure your game's volume is loud enough.
4. Usage of the Master Hand glitch is forbidden for All Events and Event IL's.
5. To verify that no savestates were used to remove RNG elements, we ask that you include your reset in your run's video. The video must show you resetting to the main menu before starting the attempt, just like on console (by pressing L+R+A+Start). You cannot load a savestate to reset. Any run suspected of using savestates or any other unapproved cheats will be rejected. (emulation requirement).
6. Allowed mods/cheats: 20XX Mod (and pretty much anything it comes with), UCF, 1 player C-Stick, Tap Jump Off, Hyrule RNG Code (for Adventure) Low-poly. More TBA.
7. If an existing submission with a video that was already approved and watched has its video removed, deleted, hidden, etc., the submission will be subject to removal. If the player in question specifically does not want their video public or able to be seen normally, and does not agree with this rule, their submission **will** be removed. The point of this website is to have a good source for speedruns with the content in public form, and unavailable videos don't save games' histories or allow other people to determine the validity of the submission in question.

8. Usage of Slippi emulator is banned for all categories

CPU Settings: It's possible to change CPU settings to manipulate DI/teching/etc. This is not allowed. They must be kept on the default settings of whichever version of Melee/20XX you choose to use, or be set to the Vanilla Melee CPU settings.

categories.name: All Events
categories.rules:
**__Timing__**
* IGT (In-game Time) is used for all submission as the main ranking timing. *(If you wish to submit with RTA as well, use the following timing methods below)*
* **Time Starts:** When you select the 1st event of your choice.
* **Time Ends:** At the final **"Success!"** of the last event in your run.
* IGT from failures or retries need to be added to the Total IGT. *(Note: Even if you accidentally enter an Event that you may have already completed prior, the IGT before quitting out needs to be also added)*

**__Timing Tip__**
* Events with **a timer** that count up, the IGT shown is the final time.
* Events with **time limits** is counted as: Starting Time - Ending Time (like in Classic).
* Events that just track points and make you play the whole thing (like Event 11), you enter the full IGT for the stage in an All Events run (so 1 minute 2 seconds or 62 seconds for that one).
* PSA: For **"Event 36: Space Travelers"**, if the 1st segment is 30s or more, the IGT for the stage is simply the final time shown. If segment 1 is under 30s, calculate the stage IGT as follows: Segment 1 time + (Final Time - 30s).

categories.name: Classic
categories.rules:
**__General__**
* Any amount of Stocks is allowed.
* All runs that use RNG Manipulation must show the console hard resetting or the previous run beforehand. The video must include the whole RNG Manipulation process.

**__Timing__**
* IGT (In-game Time) is used for all submission as the main ranking timing. *(If you wish to submit with RTA as well, use the following timing methods below)*
* **Time Starts:** When you press the Start button on the Character Select Screen.
* **Time Ends:** At the final hit on Master Hand.
* IGT from failures or retries need to be added to the Total IGT.

categories.name: Adventure
categories.rules:
**__General__**
* Any amount of Stocks is allowed.

**__Timing__**
* IGT (In-game Time) is used for all submission as the main ranking timing. *(If you wish to submit with RTA as well, use the following timing methods below)*
* **Time Starts:** When you press the Start button on the Mushroom Kingdom intro scene.
* **Time Ends:** When the final **"Game!""** during the final Bowser fight (This will either be Bowser or Giga Bowser depending on the run)
* IGT from failures or retries need to be added to the Total IGT.

categories.rules:

**__Timing__**

categories.name: All Trophies
categories.rules:
**__General__**
* Your run must start from a new save file.
* A Pikmin save file *(or any Trophies that can't be obtained through in-game means, which are required for the **"You have all the trophies!!"** message)* may already be on the memory card prior to the run. *(See [Resources](https://www.speedrun.com/ssbm/resources) if you need a save file.)*

**__Timing__**
* RTA (Real Time Attack) is used for all submission as the main ranking timing. 
* **Time Starts:** On the 1st Black Frame after pressing Start on the Title Screen.
* **Time Ends:** On the frame that **"You have all the trophies!!"** message begins to appear on the screen.
* IGT from failures or retries need to be added to the Total IGT.

**__Master Hand Glitch is Allowed__**
* Due to majority of runners of the category being in favor of it, it will be allowed!

runList.comment: Beat my time by 4 minutes, hoping to improve to sub 45 soon!

Total times for each Event Match: https://pastebin.com/uvSP4gqi

Totals to 2,843.75 seconds aka 47 Minutes, 22.75 seconds.

This was my first run of All Event Matches. It was pretty bad, as I made a lot of mistakes and took my time in some areas. It was mainly a practice run to figure out strategies and to gain experience. I didn't calculate the IGT as I plan on improving this run shortly.

played on orignal hardware.

So bad. But for the first time ever, I finished all events in a row.

Mod notes: Changed IGT from 1:20:27.940 to 1:20:24.200

-IGT-
Event 51-41: 26:48.76
Event 40-31: 15:51.87
Event 30-21: 17:40.66
Event 20-11: 12:29.77
Event 10-1: 7:33.14

Full Calculation -> https://www.mediafire.com/file/2cu923ko0663dx4/sascha-gaming_1H20M24S20MS_IGT_Calculation.txt/file <-
This run is a pain, I'm just happy I got the hour sub.
My Current PB for all 51 Events
still the worst time but a massive improvement, i can definitely fix a lot of the errors I made
